basics.name: Nguyen Ngoc Quy
basics.label: Software Engineer | C++ Systems, AI Infrastructure & Backend Tooling
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience in high-performance C++ systems, backend tooling, and local AI infrastructure. Specialized in containerized vLLM serving, agentic routing gateways, tool-calling workflows, and large-scale server stress testing. Proven track record of optimizing latency, concurrency, and developer productivity across distributed teams.

work.name: Gameloft
highlights: Local LLM Infrastructure & Serving (Jun 2026–Present): Deployed containerized LLM inference engines on multi-GPU nodes; optimized vLLM memory allocation, KV-cache, context length, concurrency, and speculative decoding via reproducible stress and tool-use benchmarks.

LLM Gateway & Agentic Routing: Engineered an Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible AI Gateway in TypeScript to route agentic developer tools (Claude Code, OpenCode) across local vLLM instances and cloud models with streaming protocol translation, authentication, and PostgreSQL usage metering.

Automated Crash Analysis Pipeline: Architected an AI-assisted Linux core-dump diagnostic platform (S3 → WSL/GDB with archived symbols) that retrieves contextual stack traces, groups related crashes, and leverages LLMs for automated root-cause analysis and patch proposals via a PostgreSQL dashboard.

Automated SVN Code Review System: Developed a model-agnostic code review platform for SVN repositories featuring scheduled LLM evaluations, finding classification, verdict tracking, and notification workflows backed by PostgreSQL.

Backend Load & Stress Testing: Built an automated testing platform simulating thousands of concurrent connection players to stress-test game backend servers and event APIs prior to production deployment.
Core C++ & Client-Server Gameplay: Developed high-performance C++ gameplay systems and features across both client and server, contributing to Android platform porting and optimization.

Cross-Stack & SDK Delivery: Delivered core features across ActionScript legacy titles and Unreal Engine 5 migration projects, integrating third-party backend SDKs including Netflix and regional distribution platforms.
CI/CD Infrastructure: Designed and maintained Jenkins build and deployment pipelines for Sniper Fury, improving release stability and operational efficiency.
Technical Leadership: Led technical workshops and programming contests while mentoring junior engineers and standardizing technical documentation in fluent business English.
